title: Limit interest calculator to 1 year maximum using days input

requirements.text: Replace the 'years' input field in the interest calculator form with a 'days' input field that accepts values from 1 to 365 days

quotes: interest calc me bs 1 year bala rakh days ke form me hi

acceptanceCriteria: Input accepts only integer values between 1 and 365
Validation error appears if user enters a value outside this range
Placeholder text shows example like '90' or '180'

requirements.text: Update the frontend interest calculation logic to convert days to a fraction of a year (days/365) before performing the calculation
acceptanceCriteria: Results display correctly for any valid days input
Precision is maintained for partial year calculations

requirements.text: Update the results display to show the number of days used in the calculation alongside the principal, interest, and total
acceptanceCriteria: Days value matches the user's input
Display formatting is consistent with existing result fields

requirements.text: Update the validation utility to replace year validation (0-30) with days validation (1-365)
acceptanceCriteria: validateInput.ts checks for days range instead of years
Minimum value is 1 day, maximum is 365 days

constraints: Do not modify the backend calculation logic in main.mo
Maintain existing currency formatting and display patterns
Keep the principal amount validation unchanged (0-10M range)
nonGoals: Changing the backend interest calculation methods
Modifying the overall calculator page layout or styling
Adding date picker or calendar UI components
